name: OmaKeys
author: skvggor
description: Shows the keys you press and the mouse buttons you click as a floating on-screen overlay plus a bar indicator. Made for screencasts, live demos, and teaching.

barWidget.description: Floating key display + bar indicator driven by an evdev daemon

schema.label: Floating overlay
schema.description: Display the keys you press as a floating overlay on the focused monitor.

schema.label: Show mouse clicks
schema.description: Surface mouse button clicks and scrolling on the overlay.

schema.label: Overlay vertical position (%)
schema.description: How far down the screen the overlay sits. 50 is the center.

schema.label: Max visible keys
schema.description: How many recent key entries the overlay keeps at once.
